title: Google Gemma Inference Hits 108,000 Tokens per Second via Gemini 4 Argon

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google's latest optimization for the gemma-4-E2B-it model has improved processing performance by 2.85x on Nvidia A100 GPUs. Using the vLLM framework and Gemini 4 Argon, the model's throughput increased from approximately 37,900 to over 108,000 tokens per second.

The acceleration was implemented across 8 pull requests over several days. The update maintained 100% token parity with no drop in quality.
